us_scales: On US scales: crime, road noise and flood risk are scored against California's own figures, and prices among the Bay Area's 50 cities alone. Not comparable with a UK score, nor with New York's.
growth_not_scored: FHFA's price trend is county-wide, so the Bay Area's 50 cities hold only four values, and scaled against each other they read as extremes they do not have; context.priceTrendPct reports the county's change as a fact
